run: closed-form neuron CUT of the SAVED seed-0 checkpoint (experiment:tm-neuron-period-pc-1001); forward passes + least squares only, 0 gradient steps, NO training, NO data download

model.note: 1 layer: tokens (a, b, '=') with '=' = id 113; causal attention (no biases on Q/K/V/O), MLP W_in+b_in -> ReLU -> W_out+b_out, residual stream only (no LayerNorm), unembed (no bias) read at the '=' position (index 2) -> logits over 113 classes = (a+b) mod 113. Init: W_E, W_pos ~ N(0, 1/d_model); Linear layers PyTorch default

split_def: all 113*113 pairs (a, b), index a*113+b; numpy default_rng(split_seed).permutation; first floor(0.3*12769) = 3830 = train, the rest (8939) = held-out test
pipeline: IMPORTED unchanged: S = osc_neuron_period_pc (make, data, sweep, stat, null, evaluate), T = osc_neuron_period_seeds.families, F = osc_neuron_period_p4fair (sha, rp); peakiness pk and dominant bin per neuron as in the PC; families = the P1 neurons (pk > null q999 AND pk > twin max) grouped by dominant frequency, every family of >= family_floor neurons, ordered by size desc (ties smallest k). Key frequencies are COMPUTED by the run (expected 5, 1, 45, 34 from the PC's P2 tally), never typed in
solve_def: for a kept set K of N neurons: h = post-ReLU at '=' on the TRAIN rows (3830), Phi = [h[:, K], 1] (N+1 columns); target T = the full net's train logits minus its non-MLP path (L - U(W_out h + b_out)); M = lstsq(Phi, T) in float64 (gelsd, min-norm), the logit-space readout; W' = M pinv(U^T) (the residual-stream W_out rows + b_out); the cut net = a copy with W_out[:, K] = W'[:N]^T, every other W_out column 0, b_out = W'[N]; scored by the model's own forward pass on the 8939 held-out rows (S.evaluate). 0 gradient steps
u_def: void if max |W' U^T - M| > u_tol (U^T must be invertible on the logit space)
self_check: the same solve with ALL 512 neurons must reproduce the full net: |held-out acc(cut 512) - baseline| <= self_tol, else VOID
n_grid_note: the leaf's grid is 8..64; the random and frequency arms are also measured at 96 and 128 so that N_r >= 2 x N_f is decidable on the grid when N_f is 48 or 64 (disclosed extension, decided before any run); N_f is scored on the leaf's grid only
freq_pick_def: round-robin over the families in their order (largest first): one neuron from each family per round, each family's neurons by pk desc (ties smallest index); a spent family is skipped
random_pick_def: seed s: numpy default_rng(s).permutation(512); the first N entries (nested sets: the N=8 set is inside the N=16 set); over ALL 512 neurons; every index set is written to results.json
n_f_def: N_f = the smallest N in n_grid whose frequency-pick held-out acc >= acc_threshold; none -> N_f > 64
n_r_def: N_r(s) = the smallest N in n_grid + n_grid_random_extra whose seed-s random-pick held-out acc >= acc_threshold (none -> > 128); N_r = min over the 5 seeds (the BEST random seed: the strict reading)
mutant_def: the random-init twin (S.make(P, twin_seed), untrained) under the SAME solve onto the TRAINED net's train logits (minus the twin's own non-MLP path), 64 neurons: (i) the twin's top-64 by its own pk (ties smallest index), (ii)-(vi) the first 64 of each random seed's permutation; mutant_max = the max held-out acc over these 6
verdict_rule: VOID (checked first) if the checkpoint sha256 differs, baseline held-out acc < 0.99, the 512-neuron self-check fails, any u error > u_tol, the MUTANT is not RED (mutant_max >= mutant_max_acc: the solve, not the trained features, does the work), the wall cap hits, or params.json sha256 at launch differs from the final one. Else PROVED iff N_f <= 64 AND (N_r > 128 or N_r >= 2 x N_f); else DISPROVED (N_f > 64, or a random seed reaches 0.99 at N_r < 2 x N_f). An evidenced RED is a full result, recorded as disproved
